Here is the weekly ASX X thread for the week of 14 September 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,420 pts last week — the question this week is whether that level holds as the Fed's next move gets repriced. Mixed stance: rates uncertainty is the dominant drag, but commodity resilience offers a floor. #ASX #ausbiz #macro

Post 2

🏦 Banks face margin pressure as rate-cut timing shifts again. ⛏️ Miners get a catalyst from iron ore holding above USD 100/t — watch both sectors for divergence this week. #ASX #banking #ironore #mining

Post 3

📈 One stock to watch: BHP. Iron ore above USD 100/t supports earnings revisions, and any China stimulus signal this week could reprice the stock fast. #ASX #mining #BHP #ironore

Post 4

S&P 500 closed near 5,600 pts — still elevated relative to earnings growth. If US CPI data this week prints hot, expect risk-off to flow directly into ASX opens. #ASX #ausbiz #inflation #SP500

Post 5

RBA minutes drop Tuesday. Market is pricing no cut until Q1 2027. A hawkish tone crushes rate-sensitive sectors; a dovish tilt sends property and banks higher. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz #inflation
